items.text: {"title": "Podcast edit review — Ep. 47 (AI assistants in the newsroom)", "start": "2025-03-11T15:00:00Z", "end": "2025-03-11T16:00:00Z", "description": "Go over the rough cut for the episode on newsroom chatbots before it goes to mastering.\n"}

**Claim review — KLM-88214 (water damage, garage)**
Wed 19 Feb, 10:30–11:15, Room 3B. Bring the assessor's photos and the adjuster chatbot transcript summary.

Name: Complaint triage sync — ticket #55021 (delivery delay, Bridgtown order). Time: Thursday 27 March, 14:00–14:45, video call. We'll walk through the customer's email, the refund policy for late deliveries, and the draft reply from the support chatbot that got flagged for tone. Priya will bring the order timeline, and Marco has the warehouse note about the courier mix-up. Goal is to agree on a resolution and who sends the final response. Please read the thread before joining.
Standup moved: Fri 08:45, #eng-daily. Topic: the codereview-bot rollout and whether it should run on every PR or only on request.

Podcast recording — Season 3, Episode 12 ("Can a chatbot explain your policy?"). Booked for Tue 8 April, 18:00–19:30 in Studio B. We'll record the intro, the interview segment with Dana from Meridian Insurance, and the listener mailbag. Nadia is handling levels, and the producer wants a clean copy before Friday. Bring your notes on the claims story and the list of questions, and try to arrive ten minutes early to test the mics. Snacks are on the label budget this time.

Insurance claim walkthrough — claim #C-4471 (storm damage, 14 Fenwick Road)

Thursday 13 March, 09:00–10:00, claims room 2. We'll go through the assessor report, the policy schedule, and the customer's follow-up calls so we can decide whether to approve the roof portion as submitted.

Agenda:
- 09:00 Review of photos and assessor notes (Hannah)
- 09:20 Coverage questions: gutters vs. roof line
- 09:35 Draft response to the customer
- 09:50 Next steps and target decision date

Background: the claim was opened after the storm on 2 March, and the first automated triage pass routed it to manual review. The customer has asked twice for an update, so we should come out of this meeting with a date to give them.

Please skim the file in the claims portal beforehand. If you can't make it, send your notes to Hannah and we'll fold them in.

Meeting notes will be posted to the claims channel afterwards, and the customer-facing summary will be drafted by Priya once we agree on the coverage position. Dial-in details are in the calendar invite.
Podcast guest prep call: Mon 24 Feb, 11:15–11:45. Quick chat with the producer about the chatbot segment and what we can promise listeners.
Complaint follow-up: ticket #55109, Thu 3 April 16:00–16:30. Read the customer's second email and the refund options sheet first.

Weekly complaint review — Friday 21 March, 15:30–16:15, large meeting room. We'll look at the five open tickets from the north region, including the one where the support chatbot suggested a refund the policy doesn't allow. Tess will present the trend summary and Owen has the revised escalation script. Bring any tickets you think need a second opinion.

Podcast edit lock — Ep. 48 ("When the chatbot gets it wrong"). Tuesday 6 May, 10:00–12:00, edit suite 1. Final pass on levels, the cold open, and the disclaimer read at the top. Please have the show notes to Lena by Monday evening so they can go out with the feed.
